batches.title: Offline Interactive Scene Foundation
batches.status: development build; manual browser QA pending
implemented: Canvas projected 3D-style scene with grid
Orbit and zoom interactions
Cube/sphere/pillar editing
Object selection and transformations
Scene JSON import/export with schema validation
Local structural QA
batches.regression_note: Standalone Module 13 file; no changes to Module 12 Batch 15

batches.name: WebGL Scene Engine & Advanced Object Controls
batches.preserves: Module 13 Batch 1 canvas editor and JSON import/export
implemented: Native WebGL 1 shader-based 3D cube/pillar and low-poly sphere previews
Canvas fallback toggle
Orbit/zoom WebGL interactions
GPU depth testing
Context-loss fallback
Existing object transforms and JSON import/export retained
limitations: WebGL availability depends on browser/GPU
Manual browser QA pending
No WebXR headset support or camera AR
No production deployment

batches.name: Scene Presets, Object Duplication & Offline Local Save
implemented: Three preset scenes: showroom, gallery, architecture
Duplicate selected object with unique ID
Explicit browser-local save, load and clear
Scene schema validation on local load
Existing Canvas and WebGL preview preserved
limitations: Local save is browser-specific and may be unavailable in private browsing
No automatic cloud synchronization
No WebXR or camera AR

batches.name: Bounded Undo/Redo Scene History
implemented: Undo and redo controls for scene edits
Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z shortcuts outside text inputs
40-step bounded in-memory history
History controls update disabled state
Preserves existing scene schema, WebGL/Canvas renderer, presets and local storage
limitations: History is in-memory only and resets on reload
Asynchronous JSON import and local load are not yet tracked
Fine-grained slider inputs each create a history entry

batches.name: Camera View Presets
implemented: Front, Side and Top camera view buttons
Camera preset changes use existing scene view state and Undo/Redo history
Existing zoom level retained when switching camera views
Canvas and WebGL previews continue using shared view state
limitations: Top view pitch is limited to the existing 1.2 radian camera clamp
Manual browser regression QA still required

batches.name: Read-only Scene Inspector & Statistics
implemented: Live object count grouped by cube, sphere and pillar
Selected object ID, type, position and scale readout
Canvas or WebGL renderer mode indicator
Read-only inspector preserves scene schema, local save, JSON import/export and Undo/Redo
limitations: Browser interaction and renderer mode toggling require manual QA
Statistics are for current in-browser scene only

batches.name: Session Camera Bookmark & Restore
implemented: Bookmark current camera yaw, pitch and zoom
Restore saved camera viewpoint without changing scene objects
Restore action participates in existing Undo/Redo history
Restore disabled until bookmark exists
No changes to scene JSON schema or local save
limitations: Bookmark is in-memory and clears on reload
Only one bookmark is supported
Manual Canvas/WebGL regression testing required

batches.name: Session Object Visibility Controls
implemented: Hide or show selected scene object without deletion
Show All restores hidden objects
Hidden objects omitted from Canvas and WebGL preview and canvas picking
Object list marks hidden objects; inspector shows visible count
Visibility state remains session-only; scene JSON schema and local storage unchanged
limitations: Visibility is session-only and resets on scene reload or Undo/Redo scene restore
Visibility changes are not individually undoable
Manual browser QA and regression testing required

batches.name: Session Object Lock & Editing Protection
implemented: Lock and unlock selected object; Unlock All
Locked object remains selectable and visible but cannot be moved or scaled via sliders
Remove and Duplicate blocked for locked object at both UI and handler levels
Object list shows Locked marker
Lock state is session-only; no scene schema or database changes
limitations: Locks reset on scene load, reset, or undo/redo scene restoration
Lock/unlock is not itself undoable
Browser regression testing pending

batches.name: Object Search & Scene Navigator
implemented: Search object list by case-insensitive ID or object type
Live filtered count without changing scene objects
Select objects from filtered results
Preserve selection, locks, visibility, Canvas/WebGL rendering and saved scene format
Clear search to restore full object list
limitations: Search matches only object ID and type, not coordinates
Manual browser QA and regression testing required

batches.name: Scene Navigator Filters & Sorting
implemented: Filter scene navigator by cube, sphere or pillar
Filter by visible, hidden, locked or unlocked status
Sort navigator by object ID ascending or descending, or original scene order
Combine search text with status and type filters
Navigator filtering never changes scene data, renderer order or JSON format
limitations: Sorting is lexical with numeric comparison on IDs, not scene depth
Filters and sorting are not persisted across reload
Manual browser regression testing required

batches.name: Scene Navigator Quick Actions
implemented: Per-object Hide/Show button directly in navigator
Per-object Lock/Unlock button directly in navigator
Accessible action labels include object IDs
Quick actions refresh inspector and Canvas/WebGL preview
Existing search, type/status filters and sorting retained; scene schema unchanged
limitations: Quick action changes remain session-only and are not independently undoable
Changing status may remove object from currently filtered list
Manual browser QA and regression testing pending

batches.name: Navigator Reset & Selection Tools
implemented: Reset search, type filter, status filter and sorting in one action
Clear currently selected object without deleting it
Disable Clear Selection when no object is selected
Preserve scene objects, camera, visibility, locks, Canvas/WebGL and JSON schema
limitations: Clear Selection changes only active selection; it does not clear scene contents
Manual browser and regression testing required

batches.name: Previous & Next Object Navigation
implemented: Previous and Next controls traverse current filtered and sorted navigator list
Navigation changes selection only and updates inspector and scene highlight
Navigation buttons disable at list boundaries or when list is empty
Works alongside existing search, type/status filters, sorting, Hide/Show and Lock/Unlock
No changes to scene schema, saved JSON, database or rendering algorithms
limitations: Navigation uses current list order and does not wrap around
If no selected item is in filtered results, Next selects first and Previous selects last
Manual browser and regression QA required

batches.name: First & Last Object Navigation
implemented: First Object and Last Object controls use current filtered and sorted navigator list
Buttons disable at list boundaries and when no objects match
Selection-only navigation updates inspector and scene preview
Existing Previous/Next, filters, search, visibility and locks preserved
No scene schema, database or JSON export changes
limitations: Navigation does not wrap around
Manual browser and regression QA required

overall_status: Batch 15 development committed; manual browser QA pending
